I understand the frustration of waiting for tracking information. Let me help clarify what's happening.
When you place an order with Avocado, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking details once your order ships. If you haven't received this email yet, your order is likely still in the "unfulfilled" status — meaning it hasn't been picked up for production or carrier pickup yet. Tracking details won't be available until the order actually ships.
Once your order does ship and you receive tracking, keep in mind that carriers may take several days to process and scan packages, especially during high-volume periods. Tracking often updates after the first carrier scan, so it's normal not to see immediate movement.
